thread:
incident-bot: ALERT 03:12 UTC - spike in 5xx and multiple region failovers detected for smart-route -> possible retry amplification. Paging @oncall-tilly

maria: joining. I9m seeing a steady stream of "variant-mismatch" log lines followed by immediate fallbacks to us-east-1. snippet:
```
[03:09:58] route=smart-route req=abc123 variant=redwood-v1 error=variant-mismatch
[03:09:58] route=smart-route req=abc123 fallback=region:us-east-1
[03:10:01] serve=us-east-1 req=abc123 5xx=502 backend=oom
```

kevin: are we sure clients are not retrying aggressively? If the client window is small, failover duplicates traffic and can exhaust the us-east pool (thundering herd).

maria: digging into client meta. srv-ingest has retry_policy: retries=3 base=200ms. Mobile SDKs seem to use naive linear retries.

jamal: on pager. Immediate mitigations: 1) stop cross-region fallback for the model so mismatch doesn't reroute, 2) tell the gateway to suppress client retries temporarily, 3) reduce batching window on target region. Can infra flip the policy?

infra-sre: applying dynconfig: set fallback_policy=none for route=smart-route model=redwood-v1 in eu-west-1. change_id=dc-9001.

deploy-bot: dynconfig queued dc-9001 by infra-sre. ETA ~45s.

maria: also propose gateway header injection: x-suppress-client-retries: 1 for 60s so clients obey and stop making rapid retries.

kevin: +1. Also drop batching.max_delay_ms in us-east to reduce per-host queue depth while we recover.

deploy-bot: gateway change queued dc-9002 (add header) and routing update dc-9001.

incident-bot: dc-9001 applied (eu-west-1). Failover count goes to ~0 in the next 20s. 5xx still elevated but trending down.

maria: partial improvement. 5xx down ~25%. I9m seeing variant name drift in model registry: some hosts renamed redwood-v1 -> redwood-1a during last rollout. That explains mismatch.

kevin: so sequence: partial rollout renamed variant, smart routing saw mismatch and retried to fallback region, which lacked the variant, causing errors and client retries -> amplified traffic to us-east -> OOMs/5xx.

jamal: set router to treat variant-mismatch as terminal (no fallback) for the next 10 minutes to avoid any further reroutes. infra, can you patch?

infra-sre: patching router behavior: variant-mismatch => terminal error for 10m. applied dc-9003.

opsbot: on-call handoff note: @oncall-tilly acknowledged at 03:14 UTC. next oncall: @jamal in 40m.

deploy-bot: gateway header dc-9002 applied: x-suppress-client-retries set to true for smart-route.

support-elaine: support queue: customers reporting elevated errors. AtlasHealth (enterprise) seeing 502s on nightly pipelines. Flagged as high priority. Preparing customer comms.

maria: header injection looks good; client retry volume dropped sharply. Batching delta applied in us-east lowered q depth. Still a handful of 5xx instances pinned to AtlasHealth flow.

infra-sre: initiating rolling restart of serve instances rdw-eu-1a-serve-04..07 that had OOMs. rr task rr-10011 started. ETA ~3m.

incident-bot: rolling restart rr-10011 started.

support-elaine: drafting message for AtlasHealth: "We've applied mitigations (disabled fallback, suppressed retries, restarted affected workers). Expect jobs to recover within 10-15 minutes. We'll follow up with a postmortem." ok to send?

jamal: send now and mark incident as customer-impacting. Add to timeline.

maria: restarts completed. AtlasHealth traffic shows recovery. 5xxs for their requests returned to ~0. Cluster stable.

kevin: follow-ups to file: audit rollout pipeline to avoid variant rename drift, default variant-mismatch to fail-fast (404) instead of fallback, add server-side per-client token bucket to limit retry amplification, and an alert that triggers on concurrent failover spikes + client retry bursts.

maria: creating post-incident ticket with timeline, grafana links (failover count, client retry rate, per-host q depth), and owners for follow-ups.

opsbot: severity P1 -> downgraded to P2 at 03:45 UTC. Pager cleared for current oncall.

jamal: quick retro note: root cause was three-way interaction: partial variant rename during rollout, fallback-on-mismatch routing policy, and aggressive client retry settings. Short-term fixes (disable fallback, suppress retries, rolling restart) mitigated. Long-term: rollout gating + safer fallback defaults + client-rate protections.

support-elaine: AtlasHealth notified and requested postmortem. Assigned to maria, kevin, infra-sre, support-elaine.

maria: will draft the postmortem and include a rollout checklist to prevent mid-rollout variant name changes without global registry sync.

kevin: add alert: "failover-spike-with-retry-surge" to auto-disable cross-region fallback when threshold met.

oncall-tilly: signing off initial triage. ping me if things re-escalate. :white_check_mark:

jamal: taking follow-ups on rollout gating. thanks team. :handshake:
